description: Decode the vocabulary the other ukcrime tools take: police force ids, crime category slugs, a force's neighbourhood ids, and data availability — the published months, and which forces published stop and search in each. Use it when a force, category, neighbourhood id or month is unknown; name_contains filters forces and neighbourhoods by name. The Metropolitan Police has about 680 neighbourhoods, so filter by name there; to get the force and neighbourhood covering a latitude and longitude, call ukcrime_find_neighbourhood instead.

force.description: Force id such as 'leicestershire', or its name such as 'Leicestershire Police'; case-insensitive, spaces, underscores and hyphens match each other, '&' matches 'and', and a trailing 'Police', 'Police Service' or 'Constabulary' is optional. Required for topic 'neighbourhoods'. On 'availability', where 'btp' (British Transport Police) is also accepted, adds the months this force did and did not publish stop and search. Not accepted on 'forces' or 'categories'.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Topic 'availability' only: return just that month's row.

name_contains.description: Words that must all appear in the name, in any order — case, accents and punctuation ignored, so the value needs at least one letter or digit. Topics 'forces' and 'neighbourhoods' only.

topic.description: What to list: 'forces' (force ids), 'categories' (crime category slugs), 'availability' (published months and stop-and-search publication), or 'neighbourhoods' (one force's neighbourhood ids; needs force).

name: ukcrime_list_reference

attribution.description: Open Government Licence attribution for data.police.uk data.

availability.description: Topic 'availability': the published-month window and stop-and-search publication by month.

earliest_month.description: Oldest month served, YYYY-MM (a rolling 36 months).

force.description: The force the next two lists describe, when force was given.

force_stop_search_missing_months.description: Listed months in which this force did not.

force_stop_search_published_months.description: Listed months in which this force published stop and search.

latest_month.description: Newest published month, YYYY-MM; the searches default to it.

months.description: Published months, newest first: one row when month was given, none when it is not published.

stop_search_forces_published.description: Forces, BTP included, that published stop and search.

stop_search_not_published.description: Force ids that did not publish stop and search.

name.description: Display name, also accepted as category.

slug.description: Slug the category input takes; all-crime means every category.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `force_required`: topic 'neighbourhoods' without force. `unknown_force`: force matches no listed force id or name, or more than one, or is 'btp' on topic 'neighbourhoods', or data.police.uk lists no neighbourhoods for it. `invalid_filter`: name_contains on 'categories' or 'availability', month off 'availability', or force on 'forces' or 'categories'. `rate_limited`: data.police.uk is rate-limiting this server for longer than this call can wait. `pacer_shed`: too many requests to data.police.uk are already queued in this server. `upstream_unavailable`: data.police.uk is not answering. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: data.police.uk did not answer within the time one call allows. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

force.description: Topic 'neighbourhoods': the force whose neighbourhoods are listed.

forces.description: Topic 'forces': the forces data.police.uk lists, plus British Transport Police ('btp'), which ukcrime_search_stops takes with area 'force' and ukcrime_search_crimes with area 'force_unplaced'.

gaps.description: Known coverage gaps, each ending with the date verified. Absent when none.

id.description: Force id the other tools take as force.

neighbourhoods.description: Topic 'neighbourhoods': the force's neighbourhoods, sorted by name.

id.description: Id the other tools take as neighbourhood_id; case-sensitive.

notice.description: Why a list is empty — a name filter that matched nothing, or a month that is not published — and what to do instead.

topic.description: The topic listed; its list field below is the one present.

title: List UK Police Reference Data
